item.title: agent-off-switch v0.1.0
item.description: Release v0.1.0 of agent-off-switch: Find every AI agent identity in Microsoft 365, AWS and GitHub, see what it can reach, and switch it off. Inventory, blast-radius review with SARIF, an ordered off-switch runbook per identity, and a drift gate for CI. Offline on saved read-only exports; it prints commands and never runs them.
